plugins.name: protect-mcp
plugins.description: MCP security gateway — per-tool policies, Ed25519-signed receipts, human approval gates. Shadow mode logs everything without blocking. Enforce mode applies policy. Every decision is cryptographically signed and verifiable offline.

skills.name: enforce
skills.description: Wrap an MCP server with per-tool security policies. Use when the user wants to block dangerous tools, rate-limit expensive ones, or require human approval for sensitive operations.
skills.description_zh: 为MCP服务逐工具配置安全策略，阻止危险工具、限制昂贵调用频率，或要求敏感操作先经人工审批。

skills.name: red-team
skills.description: Run attack suites against MCP security policies to verify they block what they should. Use when the user wants to benchmark a policy, test defenses, or validate OWASP MCP Top 10 coverage.
skills.description_zh: 对MCP安全策略运行攻击测试集，验证其阻挡效果，适用于策略基准、防御测试及OWASP MCP Top 10覆盖核验。

skills.name: shadow
skills.description: Wrap an MCP server in shadow mode to log all tool calls without blocking. Use when the user wants to audit or observe what an MCP server is doing, see what tools agents are calling, or start monitoring before enforcing policies.
headings: Shadow Mode — Log Everything, Block Nothing
skills.description_zh: 以影子模式封装MCP服务，记录所有工具调用而不拦截，用于观察代理调用及正式启用策略前的监测。

skills.name: verify
skills.description: Verify Ed25519-signed decision receipts offline. Use when the user wants to check receipt integrity, validate signatures, or run verification self-tests.
headings: Verify Receipts — Offline, No Account Needed
skills.description_zh: 离线验证Ed25519签名的决策回执，检查完整性、签名及验证自测。
